info.title: ghtools
info.description: Command line tools for Grasshopper .gh and .ghx files: Panel query and normalization, versioning, verification, size analysis, and safe archive edits. MIT licensed.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: ghtools: read and edit Grasshopper .gh/.ghx files

commands.name: verify
commands.description: Check structural integrity (counters, indices, dangling references)

options.name: --output
options.description: Write JSON report to a file instead of stdout

options.name: --json
options.description: Write JSON (the default output format)

arguments.name: FILE
arguments.description: Path to the .gh/.ghx file to verify

commands.name: ghx
commands.description: Export a .gh file as .ghx (XML) for human inspection or diffing

arguments.name: OUTPUT
arguments.description: Path of the .ghx file to write

commands.name: strip
commands.description: Remove internalised (persistent) data from parameters without touching wires

options.name: --output
options.description: Output .gh path (default: <name>.stripped.gh)

options.name: --in-place
options.description: Overwrite the input file (a .bak copy is kept)

options.name: --guid
options.description: Only params with these InstanceGuids

options.name: --nick
options.description: Only params (or owning objects) with this NickName

options.name: --min-items
options.description: Only params whose data has at least this many items

options.name: --only
options.description: dead | live (default: both). dead = wired params, data is ignored by GH; live = unwired, data is the value

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Report hits, write nothing

options.name: --report
options.description: Write the JSON report to this file (default: stdout)

commands.name: delete
commands.description: Remove objects and every reference to them (group membership, wires); renumber; verify

options.name: --output
options.description: Output .gh path (default: <name>.deleted.gh)

options.name: --in-place
options.description: Overwrite the input file (a .bak copy is kept)

options.name: --guid
options.description: Objects with these InstanceGuids

options.name: --name
options.description: Objects with this type name, e.g. "Panel" or "Image Sampler"

options.name: --nick
options.description: Objects with this NickName

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Report what would be removed and pruned, write nothing

options.name: --report
options.description: Write the JSON report to this file (default: stdout)

commands.name: attest
commands.description: Guided before/after verification: automated checks, then the steps only a human can do

options.name: --report
options.description: JSON report the operation wrote (strip/delete); used to audit the diff

options.name: --attest
options.description: Where to write the attestation (default: <after>.attest.json)

options.name: --auto-only
options.description: Run only the automated steps (no prompts)

commands.name: version
commands.description: Read the document version with Panel fallback, or synchronize both stored values

options.name: --set
options.description: Synchronize document and Panel versions with this major.minor.patch value

options.name: --json
options.description: Write the header and panel status as JSON

options.name: --header-only
options.description: Read only the document header and stop before DefinitionObjects

options.name: --output
options.description: Write the updated archive to a new file instead of modifying the input

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Validate a version write without modifying or creating files

commands.name: bootstrap
commands.description: Prepare the runtime dependency in the tool cache

options.name: --ghio-version
options.description: package version to use

options.name: --force
options.description: Re-download even if cached

commands.name: where
commands.description: Show which GH_IO.dll the tool resolves (without fetching)

commands.name: weigh
commands.description: List objects by size, heaviest first — what makes the file large

options.name: --top
options.description: How many objects to list (0 = all)

options.name: --json
options.description: JSON instead of a table

commands.name: panel
commands.description: Read stored Panel text by nickname

options.name: --nick
options.description: Panel nickname (case-insensitive)

options.name: --all
options.description: Return every matching Panel in document order

options.name: --json
options.description: Write structured JSON instead of a table

commands.name: normalize
commands.description: Name the Panels wired into selected component inputs; dry-run by default

options.name: --type
options.description: Component type GUID; repeat for compatible variants

options.name: --map
options.description: InputName=PanelNickName; repeat for each mapped input

options.name: --suffix
options.description: Suffix for unrelated Panels using mapped nicknames

options.name: --apply
options.description: Apply in place; a .bak copy is written only when content changes

options.name: --output
options.description: Write a changed copy to this path

options.name: --json
options.description: Write structured JSON instead of a table

commands.name: connect
commands.description: Wire an output param to an input param

options.name: --output
options.description: Output .gh path (default: <name>.connect.gh)

options.name: --in-place
options.description: Overwrite the input file (a .bak copy is kept)

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Report only, write nothing

options.name: --report
options.description: Write the JSON report to this file (default: stdout)

options.name: --from
options.description: InstanceGuid of the output param (or floating param object)

options.name: --to

commands.name: disconnect
commands.description: Remove one or all wires into an input param

options.name: --output
options.description: Output .gh path (default: <name>.disconnect.gh)

options.name: --in-place
options.description: Overwrite the input file (a .bak copy is kept)

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Report only, write nothing

options.name: --report
options.description: Write the JSON report to this file (default: stdout)

options.name: --to
options.description: InstanceGuid of the input param (or floating param object)

options.name: --from
options.description: InstanceGuid of the source to remove (default: all sources)

commands.name: clone
commands.description: Create an object by copying one from this or another file (fresh GUIDs, unwired)

options.name: --output
options.description: Output .gh path (default: <name>.clone.gh)

options.name: --in-place
options.description: Overwrite the input file (a .bak copy is kept)

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Report only, write nothing

options.name: --report
options.description: Write the JSON report to this file (default: stdout)

options.name: --guid
options.description: InstanceGuid of the object to copy

options.name: --donor
options.description: File to copy from (default: the file itself)

options.name: --nick
options.description: NickName for the copy

options.name: --at
options.description: Canvas position x,y for the copy's pivot

commands.name: set
commands.description: Update nickname, panel text or persistent data

options.name: --output
options.description: Output .gh path (default: <name>.set.gh)

options.name: --in-place
options.description: Overwrite the input file (a .bak copy is kept)

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Report only, write nothing

options.name: --report
options.description: Write the JSON report to this file (default: stdout)

options.name: --guid
options.description: InstanceGuid of the object or param

options.name: --nick
options.description: New NickName

options.name: --text
options.description: Panel text (Panels only)

options.name: --data
options.description: Persistent data values (one branch)

options.name: --goo
options.description: number | integer | boolean | text | point (inferred from existing data when omitted)

commands.name: replace
commands.description: Swap an object for a copy of another, moving wires by parameter index, then delete the old one

options.name: --output
options.description: Output .gh path (default: <name>.replace.gh)

options.name: --in-place
options.description: Overwrite the input file (a .bak copy is kept)

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Report only, write nothing

options.name: --report
options.description: Write the JSON report to this file (default: stdout)

options.name: --guid
options.description: InstanceGuid of the object to replace

options.name: --with
options.description: InstanceGuid of the replacement object (in --donor or this file)

options.name: --donor
options.description: File holding the replacement (default: this file)
